compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Explaining to a client why one of these costs more than another, or recommending an upgrade from Harmony Care to Harmony Care PLUS on the basis of better benefits. No benefit difference is published anywhere.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe Harmony Care PLUS as having more benefits than Harmony Care. Do not describe any tier of one family as better than the same tier of another. Do not quote a Harmony Care benefit from the PLUS brochure.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: State the schedule for the specific plan and tier in front of you and nothing more. If a client asks what the difference is between these families, say you will find out - do not improvise one.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Thirty-three live variants across four differently-named families publish one identical benefit set, tier for tier, and one identical 20-state availability list. Harmony Care and Harmony Care PLUS additionally share a single brochure titled for the PLUS product.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: See C-022 and C-023. This needs an answer from FirstEnroll before any comparative statement is made.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Ten of the eleven linked brochures are READ and fully extracted into the ledger, but the PDF files themselves are not in Drive. The documents behind 25 live variants therefore exist in this project only as extracted facts, not as retrievable source documents.

excluded_services.v: GENERAL: benefits will not be paid for treatment, services or supplies which are not Medically Necessary; are not prescribed by a Doctor as necessary to treat Sickness or injury; are experimental/investigational except as required by law; are received without charge or legal obligation to pay; or are provided by an immediate family member. ADDITIONAL, for sickness or injuries caused by: DENTAL PROCEDURES - dental care or treatment except for accidental injury to SOUND NATURAL TEETH within 12 months of the accident, and except where necessary due to congenital disease or anomaly. ELECTIVE PROCEDURES AND COSMETIC SURGERY, with reconstructive exceptions. FELONY OR ILLEGAL OCCUPATION. MANIPULATIONS OF THE MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM. SUICIDE, attempted suicide or intentionally self-inflicted injury, 'WHETHER SANE OR INSANE'. WAR OR ACT OF WAR, riot, insurrection, service in the Armed Forces - but losses from acts of terrorism are NOT excluded unless the covered person who suffered the loss committed the act. WORK-RELATED INJURY OR SICKNESS, whether or not workers' compensation benefits are payable. PREGNANCY.

pre_existing.v: DISCLOSED ON THE BENEFIT PAGE ITSELF as a footnote - 'There is no coverage for a Pre-existing condition for a continuous period of 12 months following the effective date of a covered person under the Policy' - and repeated in the Hospital Indemnity Insurance Limitations & Exclusions as 'Pre-existing Condition Limitation'. IT DOES NOT APPLY TO: 'newborn or newly adopted child or child under petition for adoption under the age of 18 if the child is enrolled for coverage within 90 Days from the date of birth' or 'the 60 Day period beginning on the date of adoption or filing of a petitioner for adoption'.

waiting_period_other.v: 'There is a 30 day waiting period immediately following the Coverage Effective Date; does not apply to an injury.' Restated in the exclusions as 'Sickness Benefit Waiting Period': 'There is a 30 day waiting period immediately following the Coverage Effective Date... Sickness means an illness, infection, disease, Complication of Pregnancy or any other abnormal physical condition not caused by an Accident.'
